name: Vivid tracker
description: Editable multi-table tracker with overview, filters, details and pagination.
whenToUse: Tracking records, relationships, statuses and follow-ups in one or more authorized database tables.
whenNotToUse: A custom visual experience, calculator or app without stored records; use a custom app or another template.
instructions: Inspect authorized schema and suitable existing apps first. Keep the default Vivid design unless the user requests visual customization. Use the current read_app_design kit when changing styling. Supply tabs and columns using existing table IDs, or newTables with temporary UUIDs; relationship targetTypeId may reference another new table in this same bundle. All tables and the app save atomically after confirmation. Include all needed fields; includeDetailFields keeps additional new-table fields bound and available in details while hidden from the table. Source fields are optional and appropriate for sourced research, not required on every table. Use scalar status/date and fictional examples only for empty tabs. Reuse a stable requestKey for retries, and replacesPreviewId plus expectedDigest for corrections. Read configurationSchema for supported settings.
